attributes.assessor_prompt: How much open sensory space is present between what you smell?

high_anchor.label: Very open
high_anchor.operational_definition: Clear sensory space remains around simultaneously perceived elements.

low_anchor.label: Closed
low_anchor.operational_definition: The impression is compact with no sensed space between elements.

mid_anchor.label: Partly open
mid_anchor.operational_definition: Some space is present, while portions remain compact or filled.

attributes.operational_definition: Perceived spatial openness or room between concurrent odor impressions, rated separately from strength and diffusion.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How distinctly can concurrent odor impressions be perceived?

high_anchor.label: Clearly separable
high_anchor.operational_definition: Multiple concurrent impressions remain clearly distinct.

low_anchor.label: Fused
low_anchor.operational_definition: Concurrent impressions cannot be separated perceptually.

mid_anchor.label: Partly separable
mid_anchor.operational_definition: Some impressions are distinct and others remain fused.

attributes.operational_definition: Ease of perceiving concurrent odor impressions as distinct at the same time; this is not the number of descriptors named.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How compact or filled does the overall odor impression feel?

high_anchor.label: Very dense
high_anchor.operational_definition: The odor impression is highly compact, continuous, or filled.

low_anchor.label: Sparse
low_anchor.operational_definition: The odor impression is thin or lightly occupied.

mid_anchor.label: Moderately filled
mid_anchor.operational_definition: The odor impression has an intermediate degree of sensory mass.

attributes.operational_definition: Perceived compactness or filled sensory mass. Density is measured independently and is not forced to be the inverse of airiness.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How integrated and intentionally related do the parts seem?

high_anchor.label: Highly coherent
high_anchor.operational_definition: The perceived parts form a clear and integrated whole.

low_anchor.label: Disjoint
low_anchor.operational_definition: The perceived parts conflict or appear unrelated.

mid_anchor.label: Partly coherent
mid_anchor.operational_definition: Some parts integrate while other transitions or relations remain weak.

attributes.operational_definition: Degree to which perceived parts seem integrated or intentionally related, independent of personal liking.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How closely does the sample match the declared target?

high_anchor.label: Very close match
high_anchor.operational_definition: The declared target is represented clearly across its defining features.

low_anchor.label: No match
low_anchor.operational_definition: The declared target is absent or contradicted.

mid_anchor.label: Partial match
mid_anchor.operational_definition: Several target features are present but important differences remain.

attributes.operational_definition: Match to the preregistered target description or physical reference; the response is not applicable when no target is presented.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How clearly is the declared foreground distinguished from its support?

high_anchor.label: Strong contrast
high_anchor.operational_definition: Foreground is clearly differentiated while the support remains present.

low_anchor.label: No contrast
low_anchor.operational_definition: Foreground and support cannot be distinguished.

mid_anchor.label: Moderate contrast
mid_anchor.operational_definition: Foreground is distinguishable but partially merges with its support.

attributes.operational_definition: Perceptual differentiation between preregistered foreground and background roles or adjacent construction regions.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How clearly does a new whole-mixture quality emerge?

high_anchor.label: Clear emergence
high_anchor.operational_definition: A distinct additional whole-mixture quality is perceived reproducibly.

low_anchor.label: No emergence
low_anchor.operational_definition: No additional whole-mixture quality is perceived.

mid_anchor.label: Possible emergence
mid_anchor.operational_definition: A weak or uncertain additional quality is perceived.

attributes.operational_definition: Clarity of a whole-mixture quality not attributable to any separately presented single component; requires the preregistered comparison.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How confident are you in your target choice?

high_anchor.label: Very confident
high_anchor.operational_definition: The target choice is clear and made with high confidence.

low_anchor.label: No confidence
low_anchor.operational_definition: No target choice can be made with confidence.

mid_anchor.label: Uncertain
mid_anchor.operational_definition: A target choice is possible but remains uncertain.

attributes.operational_definition: Confidence in selecting the preregistered target. Correctness is computed from the separate target-choice response, not this rating.

attributes.assessor_prompt: How pleasant or unpleasant is the sample to you?

high_anchor.label: Extremely pleasant
high_anchor.operational_definition: The sample is experienced as extremely pleasant.

low_anchor.label: Extremely unpleasant
low_anchor.operational_definition: The sample is experienced as extremely unpleasant.

mid_anchor.label: Neutral
mid_anchor.operational_definition: The sample is neither pleasant nor unpleasant.

attributes.operational_definition: Personal hedonic response, stored separately from every construction axis and never used as proof of complexity.

evidence_basis: ISO 8586:2023 public metadata - assessor selection and training

Latreille et al. 2006 - separate sensory-panel performance dimensions
Green et al. 1996 - labeled magnitude scaling evidence
